stem: At room temperature, which sequence arranges the sulfates in decreasing order of solubility in water?

verdicts.working: The solubility of Group 2 sulfates decreases down the group: MgSO₄ > CaSO₄ > SrSO₄ > BaSO₄.

working:
Solubility of Group 2 sulfates decreases down the group.
$\therefore\ \text{MgSO}_4 > \text{CaSO}_4 > \text{SrSO}_4 > \text{BaSO}_4$

Independent check: The solubility of Group 2 sulfates decreases down the group: MgSO₄ > CaSO₄ > SrSO₄ > BaSO₄.
solution:
